extracted.name: Chocolate Espresso Cupcakes with Vanilla Buttercream
extracted.description: Great recipe for Chocolate Espresso Cupcakes with Vanilla Buttercream.
instruction_lines: In a large bowl combine and thoroughly mix all dry ingredients
Slowly add milk, vegetable oil, egg and vanilla extract. Mix until well combined.
Slowly add boiling water and mix thoroughly
Evenly add mixture to a prepared cupcake tin and bake for 20 minutes
Remove cupcakes from the oven and allow to cool. While cupcakes cool prepare the frosting.
In a bowl cream the softened butter until smooth and lighter in color
Add powdered sugar 1/2 cup at a time and mixing fully
Fully combine vanilla extract and salt
Slowly add milk until desisted consistency is reached
Add frosting to a piping bag and top each cupcake
